title: Unit Event — Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky — Episode2 A Special 24-Hour Livestream!

meta.Event: Chasing The Sparkle Beyond the Blue Sky
meta.Event Outline: Feeling the need for further practice leading up to their solo show, MORE MORE JUMP! decide to do a training camp that doubles as a streaming project. They start doing a variety of exercises under a special program devised by Airi, but something seems to be worrying Minori...

rows.Line: Two weeks later
Beach

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Alright, here we go!
From the MORE MORE JUMP! Solo Show Training Camp, we're here to bring you...
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: The nearly 24-hour livestream!

rows.Speaker: Haruka & Minori
rows.Line: Yay♪

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<We get to watch MMJ for an entire day?! You girls are the best!>
<Is this an overnighter? The beach looks like so much fun!>
<What are you gonna do there?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you all for tuning in.
Our hope is that you'll get to see many different sides of us today, so please enjoy.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we don't even know what we're actually doing yet...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Wait, what do you mean?>
<Improvised training camp...?>
<Shouldn't you come up with a plan?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<What's Airi up to?>
<One of these girls knows more than the others.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Hehe. I see that some of you have already figured out what's going on.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We actually had Airi come up with our entire plan for this training camp, including where we'd be going and what we'll be doing.

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<I knew it!>
<She is pretty good at planning and stuff.>
<Does this mean Airi came up with a crazy list of activities?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. You got it. On top of some pretty tough stuff, I've come up with a list of activities that I think you, the viewers, will really enjoy!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Way to go, Airi!>
<Can't wait lol>
<I'll get my fingers ready for some nonstop screenshotting!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Then, let's jump right in!
There's no time to waste at this training camp!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Right.
I can't say for sure if we'll make it through the end, but we promise to do our best and grow as much as we can!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But we still don't actually know how we're gonna train.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
I'm sure Airi won't disappoint.
I'm looking forward to seeing what kind of plan she's come up with for us.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That raises the bar a bit... But to start things off, I'd like to see what you're all capable of!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wh-What we're capable of?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. So, here's the big reveal. First, I'd like to have you all ride on...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This banana boat!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A banana boat...?

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Banana boat training...?>
<Idols on a banana boat? Sign me up!>
<What's a banana boat? How's it different from a regular boat?>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: This is the type that gets towed by a motorboat, right? I see these at tourist destinations a lot...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's exactly right.
I rented it for us just for today.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Oh, I see.
But... What sort of training are we doing with it?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I'm puzzled too!
Riding it sounds more like a fun activity than training or exercise.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Heh heh heh,
Riding it is only half of the story. This is where we have... A MORE MORE MISSION!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Woohoo!>
<I knew it wasn't that simple lol>
<Do you have to do something once you've gotten on?>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, allow me to explain as both the producer and presenter!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: For this training activity, you'll be riding the banana boat one at a time. Then, while you're out on the water, I'll give the signal...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Give the signal...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'll give the signal for you to face the camera and hit everyone with a dazzling, idol-like smile!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That's it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yup, that's it.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hmm... This still seems kinda too fun to be true...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Could it be that there's a surprise involving the boat?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Maybe we're going to get towed so fast that we'll have trouble hanging onto it?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: This isn't a variety show, so I won't have you do anything like that. If anything, I want this to be as safe as possible, so it won't be going that fast.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: She did say that it's meant to be a test to see what we're capable of. It shouldn't be that difficult, right...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hehe. We'll see.
So, without further ado, Shizuku, you're leading us off...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: M-Me?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh! Batting first... It's Shizuku!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I can't really guarantee any good results, but I promise to try my best...!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm ready!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, you seem set.
I'll give them the signal to cast off!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Please be careful, Shizuku!
A whale might pop out from below to use its blowhole! You never know!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not sure that's going to happen...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I-I'll do what I can to keep my composure if a whale does decide to pay us a visit...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, settle down. I'm gonna start counting down now. Three...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: Two...

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: One...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Go!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Eep...!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Whoa!
They're already way over there!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. This banana boat's so incredible. I feel like I'm flying across the water.
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The wind must feel so nice.
At the same time, all seems rather normal...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah...
Oh, maybe Shizuku's noticed something!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Hey, Shizuku!
Is everything okay?!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku's Voice
rows.Line:
Yes!
I just saw some fish jumping out of the water! I wish you were there to see them!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! That sounds amazing! I really wanna go on it now!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Hehe. It does look like fun...
But it looks like we don't have to worry about any extra surprises. Which means, this training is about...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. Way to go, Shizuku...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Huh?
What's that supposed to...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She seems to be cruising along nicely, so I think it's time we moved on to the mission.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Shizuku...!
Get ready to turn this way and hit us with an idol smile!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
An idol smile...?
Like this?
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Whoa... Talk about a killer smile!>
<I couldn't help but bow to her.>
<I don't know what's brighter! The sun or Shizuku's smile!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: S-So many comments...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
I can see why too.
Her smile goes so perfectly with this seascape that she's overwhelming... No, blinding us with her aura.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you think, Minori?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Well...
As a huge fan of idols...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: The way she's gracefully gliding across the water is only adding to her beauty, like she's a water nymph! It's so fitting since “Shizuku” also means droplet!

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<Minori gets it.>
<Can't argue against Minori's stamp of approval.>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And it looks like they all agree with you, Minori.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Minori, I take it that Shizuku gets a perfect 100 for her dazzling smile...?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah!
I'd give her 10 billion points if I could!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I get how you feel, but I'm not sure we can handle a score of that magnitude. So, let's stick with 100...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Anyway, Shizuku, come on back to shore!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Okay!
Mr. Driver, if you will.
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Wow... That felt incredible.
Riding on a boat was so much fun.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Welcome back, Shizuku.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Shizuku, your smile was unbelievable! It was like you'd somehow grabbed ahold of my heart and wouldn't let go!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wait, we all get to see each other's smiles... Is this a test of how much idol power our hearts can handle...?!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you talking about?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm still a bit puzzled as to what this activity was about as well. I sort of just ended up enjoying myself.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I think I'm starting to understand what Airi meant by “what we're capable of” if this really is just about our individual idol smiles...

rows.Speaker: Comments
rows.Line:
<But why the banana boat? Is it really necessary?>
<Airi?! Coming up with a botched plan?!>
<^^^ There's no way!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Hehe. That's what I like to see. Nice reactions, everyone.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
But there's nothing to worry about.
For now, please sit back and enjoy as we all take our turns. Sound good?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So, Haruka, you're up next.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
*Gasp*
I get to see Haruka smiling as she glides across the water...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm not sure that I can match Shizuku's brilliance, but I'll try my best...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Okay, here we go.
Viewers, let's count down together!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Three...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
(Well, I'm aboard...
Nothing seems particularly out of the ordinary.)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (But there's no way Airi would ever have us do a meaningless activity. There must be something that I'm still missing, so I'll need to keep my eyes peeled...)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Two...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: One!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Go!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Whoa!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So much force...!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Bye, Haruka!
Have fun!
se_event_blue_2022_001

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Now I understand...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Well done, Airi. What a great idea.)
se_event_blue_2022_001
se_event_blue_2022_001
